question: What all-pervading manifestation quickly arises for that liberated being?
premises: It is all and all-pervading for that very person.
inference: For that liberated being, the all-pervading totality manifests swiftly.
uncertainties: The subject of pravartate is elliptic; taken as the all-pervading reality.
plain_english: For him it quickly arises; for him alone all becomes all-pervading.
